parsed.summary: The PR fixes the IndexError in `sylow_subgroup()` by correctly handling non-minimal blocks. It also adds a reproduction script and additional test cases.

issues.description: The PR introduces a new file `reproduce_error.py` which is not aligned with the project's convention of keeping test files separate.
